Advertisement No. NPSC/ESTT-4/2024 dt. 10.06.2025 
 Published on : 10-06-2025 05:01 pm 
 NAGALAND
PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION 
 NAGALAND:
KOHIMA 
 No.NPSC/ESTT-4/2024 
 Dated,
the 10 th June, 2025 
 ADVERTISEMENT 
 With reference to Government letter No. PAR-B/17/2009 dated 25 th July,
2024, applications are invited from BT
KONYAK for filling up 1 (one) post of MTS under the Nagaland Public Service
Commission in the manner prescribed below: 
 1. Name
of post : Multi Tasking
Staff. 
 2. Number
of post(s) : 1 (one) 
 3. Scale
of pay : Level-1 A as per
ROP Rules, 2017. 
 4. Age
as on 01-01-2025 : Between 18 to 32 years.
Upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years in case of SC/ST candidates. 
 5. Educational
Qualification: 1) Cl-VIII passed 
 2)
Preference will be given to candidates with Multi Tasking background. 
 6. How
to apply : Candidates who wish to apply
may submit their application in plain paper along with supporting documents
addressed to the Secretary, NPSC from 11-06-2025 
onwards. 
 7. Last
date of submission of application: 18-06-2025
till 12:00 Noon . 
 Note :
Supporting Documents to be submitted:- 
 1) Class-VIII
or above Marksheet/ Pass Certificate. 
 2) Birth
Certificate or HSLC Admit Card. 
 3) Indigenous
Inhabitant Certificate. 
 4) Scheduled
Tribe Certificate. 
 5) Backward
Tribe Certificate. 
 6) Marksheet/
Certificate of additional qualification, if any. 
 (NUNGSANGMENLA
IMCHEN) 
 Secretary, 
 Nagaland
Public Service Commission,
